title: Register the reviewed Growth source and real API staging for migration readiness

source.ref: Owner-directed analytics completion; independently reviewed LIVE-2280 Growth PR #4997.

detail: Adds only one finite main-owned registration for Growth #4997, freezing all 36 reviewed paths and modes, SQL60000 hash and exact db-tests workflow. Required success includes all existing room, Launch, calendar and analytics-experiment API checks plus the new Growth API acceptance, full replay, pgTAP, skip enforcement and cleanup. Every existing registration remains byte-equivalent. The new capability probe fails on unchanged main766068a because no Growth registration exists, then passes on this policy with explicit synthetic facts. Negative cases reject missing API evidence, changed source, moving heads and orphan ledger entries. Synthetic probe success is not actual staging, production application or merge permission. Real exact-head staging and fresh trusted readiness remain mandatory; no SQL or feature flag is changed. Growth is mechanically retimed from unapplied52000 to60000 after independently owned Claude #4994/#4998 claimed52000; no Claude files or SQL bodies change. Root publicly reserved Growth60000 and Quest61000 at coordination issue4306 comment6888632211. Source inventory is independently recomputed after retiming; earlier local policy/backlog checks cover the initial reviewed registration, and final targeted capability and hosted checks must validate the refreshed pins.
